Render ONE character only as a finished cinematic LookDev beauty frame. Preserve real three-dimensional facial planes, shoulder/chest volume, hair mass and individual strands, real cloth thickness and layered ancient Chinese costume. Do not create a character sheet, turnaround collage, ghost copies, flat concept art, watercolor, paper texture, 2D cutout or Japanese school-anime styling.
